description: smc_uas_airport_notification_areas is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (data.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. This dataset shows areas in San Mateo County where Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) operators must not interfere with manned aircraft operations and notify the airport operator or control tower before operating a UAS. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has issued regulations for flying Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) or, more commonly, drones. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Government. Its tags are faa, drones, airports. The table has 2 columns. Attribution on the portal: San Mateo County Airports. The portal shows 2015-05-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-smcgov-org-portal.
